exam.title: Feature test — practice exam
exam.description: A short exam for trying every SmartProctoring feature. Not a real exam.
exam.instructions: You have 20 minutes. Keep your face visible to the camera. You may pause; the timer stops while paused and you repeat the identity check when you return.

questions.prompt: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
Which of these are prime numbers? (Select all that apply.)
What is 2.5 + 1.25? (You may type a comma or a point.)
What is the capital city of Nigeria?
In a few sentences, describe your favourite place and why you like it.
